size_why: The change count is inflated by broad tuning, but two structural moves decide it: a three-part comeback package (non-hero gold 26%→30%, Haunted Souls secure up to 50% faster when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) reverses the 'leads stick' economy, and Radiant Regeneration plus Healing Booster being gutted in the same patch as anti-heal buffs and Healbane stacking deletes the regen-stack build family. Haunt bounty/HP/damage all +10% also reprices the entire off-lane farm the last two patches were built around.
headline: The comeback valve is open again, and regen stacking is dead — anti-heal and lifesteal own the sustain slot now.

meta_thesis.previous: Souls sit off-lane in a coverage problem no five-man can solve; AoE clearers and Heavy Melee crate openers bank first, lane bullies convert pressure, leads stick, and tempo usually closes the lobby before a late spike.
meta_thesis.new: Off-lane farm is richer but a farm lead is now a soft lead: trailing teams secure contested Haunted Souls faster, get tick souls to their two poorest, and can farm their way back, so games run longer and sustained-farm carries and late spikes get a real window. Sustain itself migrates from regen stacking to in-fight lifesteal, because anti-heal is everywhere.
meta_thesis.why: The KB's core economic read ('comeback bounties trimmed, extra souls reroute to the two lowest-econ players, leads stick') is directly undone by non-hero comeback gold 26%→30%, Haunted Souls securing up to 50% faster at a 20% net-worth gap, and tick souls now feeding the two poorest — while the tempo assassins who converted early leads lose Steam Vent invisibility and tunnel speed +70%→+50%.

winners.why: Riposte disable 0.8s→1.5s plus dash reliability and CC refunds on Flawless Advance/Itani Lo Sahn remove his whiff windows; the longer immobilize also fits a patch where fights are picked, not sieged.

Flask travel +40% and shred -25%→-30%, Willpower +15%→+20%, and Last Stand T2 +40.5→+50 DPS with -30s→-40s cooldown — and Steam Vents losing invisibility hands Shadow Weave back its exclusivity as the only invis-engage tool.

Haunt bounty and growth +10% is the single biggest income lever and his AoE clear converts it best, while Spirit Lifesteal 13%→15% and Decay -50%→-55% buff his exact core slots against the +10% camp damage.
Spirit Lifesteal, Infuser (70%→75% active, 6→8 spirit) and Torment Pulse 18%→22% melee resist all land on his slots; the Healing Booster trim is real but roughly cancelled.
Napalm T2 lifesteal 15%→20%, Concussive Combustion T3 +0.4 spirit scaling, and both Toxic Bullets 35%→40% and Decay buffed — the anti-heal patch is aimed at the fronts his burn out-ranges.

losers.why: Scrap Grenade damage and radius (8m→6m, 14m→10m) and Rule, Ratannia! (half knockup, 160s→180s, 20m→16m, 12s→9s, CD if stunned pre-place) are gutted exactly as Haunt camps gain +10% HP — his one-button clear stops being one-button.

Random brew order each cast plus 1s→1.5s cycle removes on-demand silence/barrier, and both Radiant Regeneration (~94% buy) and Healing Booster are gutted in the same patch as anti-heal buffs — the regen wall was her identity.

Her entire shell was Radiant Regeneration plus Healing Booster, both gutted, into a patch where Decay/Toxic Bullets/stacking Healbane punish regen flyers; Shining Wonder 140→125 and the 0.35→0.5 air-drag ratio compound it.

Radiant Regeneration in ~98% of her games loses spirit-regen scaling 0.35→0.25, heal-on-cast 65→40 and its out-of-combat trigger; Essence Bomb 1.22→1.35 is a real buff but it buys burst, not the grind she wins with.
Spirit per boon 1.1→0.6 plus all ability spirit damage -10% halves the stat both builds run on; +4% bullet per boon is a pivot, not a replacement.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Paige leaves S tier even though her direct nerfs read like a lane-damage trim.
non_obvious_calls.why: Base bullet damage 35→32 (growth 0.52→0.61 only breaks even around boon 33) plus the comeback package and breakables growth -10% mean she wins lane by less and converts it into less — the snowball, not the poke, was her tier.

non_obvious_calls.claim: A whole build family dies this patch, and the heroes listed for it are collateral rather than targets.
non_obvious_calls.why: Radiant Regeneration (fourth trim, in-combat only) and Healing Booster (loses Extra Regen +3 flat regen) are gutted while Decay, Toxic Bullets, Crippling Headshot and stacking Healbane all buff anti-heal — regen-stack sustain is replaced by Bullet/Spirit Lifesteal, Leech, Infuser and Vampiric Burst, so Baba/Celeste/Shiv/Lady Geist fall because their shell is gone, not because their kits were read.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The Steam Vent rework is a targeted nerf to the roam-assassin class that the last two patches had just promoted.
non_obvious_calls.why: Vents go from invisibility to +150% stamina regen and tunnels +70%→+50% speed, hitting Holliday, Calico, Lash and Bebop — heroes who bank on free approach and fast rotations — right as the comeback package blunts the early leads they convert.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Return Fire reflecting Fixation is a Haze nerf disguised as a tank item buff.
non_obvious_calls.why: Her stacking DoT is her only real scaling line, and the KB already flags her T4 gun items as the ceiling; putting a targeted counter-item on every frontline means she can no longer close kills into tanks alone.

uncertainties: Whether the comeback package actually flips leads or just lengthens games — the KB's prior comeback bounties were trimmed because they didn't move the needle.
Net effect of Haunt bounty +10% against HP and damage +10%: richer camps may still net-lose income for weak clearers, widening the coverage gap the KB already flagged rather than narrowing it.
How strong the new Halloween Cauldron Candy/Sugar Rush buff is — no numbers were given, so the frontline value is a guess.
Nurse Harrow's KB entry is thin and I have no prior tier, so my C-lean read is low confidence.
Whether the Rat King and Baba nerfs overshoot: both were tuned down in prior patches, so stacking another cut could bench them outright.
what_to_watch: Average game length and the share of games reaching the ~30-minute Broker — the cleanest test of whether the comeback valve actually slows tempo.
Win rate of teams down 5k+ net worth at 15 minutes, before and after — that single number settles the comeback debate.
Radiant Regeneration and Healing Booster pick rates versus Bullet/Spirit Lifesteal and Leech — the build-family migration in one chart.
Rat King and Baba win rates at their new tiers: if they stay near 50%, the nerfs were cosmetic; if they crater, the regen-stack removal was the real killer.
Post-rework Steam Vent kill participation and tunnel-rotation frequency — did removing invisibility actually reduce gank rate, or did stamina regen replace it?
Per-Haunt-type bounty and clear time: if one camp type dominates now that bounties are up 10%, farm routes re-converge and the no-memorization intent fails.
High-MMR anti-heal item purchase rate (Decay/Toxic Bullets/Healbane) — a spike confirms sustain comps are being punished structurally, not just on paper.
